verdicts.reason: Both are the same near-copy: the photo panel no longer bleeds to the canvas edges and sits inside thin dark strips at the top and bottom, which looks like a letterboxed mistake. The left column also floats in extra vertical space, and the SAVE 15% badge still drifts away from both the logo and the headline. B is slightly better only because it breaks the headline as 'Your coffee, / on repeat', where A leaves the weak, awkward wrap 'on / repeat'.
